modules.name: AST slicer
modules.purpose: Builds symbol and contract relationships across Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and inline HTML consumers.

modules.name: Worktree sandbox
modules.purpose: Runs candidate work in an isolated repair loop so a proposed change can be checked before delivery.
modules.evidence: 25 tests collected from the linked repository test file; candidate preference receipts are in the tournament dataset.

modules.name: Probe compiler
modules.purpose: Synthesizes targeted checks and mutates expectations to expose candidates that only satisfy superficial assertions.
modules.evidence: 48 tests collected from the linked repository test file.

modules.name: Candidate tournament
modules.purpose: Scores competing repairs, preserves chosen and rejected patches, and exports preference examples.
modules.evidence: datasets/grpo_tournament_pairs.jsonl contains 36 rows; release v15 records 321 tournament pairs seen.

modules.name: Invariant guard
modules.purpose: Checks front-end network timeouts, finite numeric inputs, cleanup, async storage, and unsafe HTML evaluation patterns.
modules.evidence: STATUS.json phase 16 records 96 frontend invariant-guard tests.

modules.name: Scan aggregation
modules.purpose: Aggregates scan evidence and impacts for reviewed changes. Raw rule hits are reported; a post-deduplication count is not recorded.
modules.evidence: STATUS.json lists 3 read-only scans and their raw rule-hit totals.

modules.name: Time travel
modules.purpose: Replays frozen evidence and attributes changes to edited lines while retaining byte hashes and probe context.
modules.evidence: STATUS.json phase 14 records 45 tests and 21 physical campaign replays.

modules.name: World model
modules.purpose: Predicts likely outcomes from recorded traces; current campaign receipts use observe mode.
modules.evidence: Validation risk head: precision 0.50, recall 1.00, support 2; no false-positive rate is reported.

modules.name: Fleet orchestration
modules.purpose: Audits delivery branches, conflicts, and default-branch cleanliness across the recorded repository fleet.
modules.evidence: artifacts/fleet_dashboard_v16.json records 15 mergeable branches and 0 conflicts.
